description: Frozen AMBI-XQC prior versus outer-terminal inner XQC with one critic, actor and temperature update after each imagined depth. Keep J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512: G3 is the total round budget, split into one shared update slot at each H3 depth. Inner policy delay one gives C18/A18/T18 per decision; outer policy delay remains inherited and unchanged. Final-horizon bootstrap uses the frozen persistent actor and outer online critic with current inner entropy temperature.

budget_source.scope: Rollout and shared update-slot budgets only; this is native XQC, not SAC.

controller.description: Seed-paired prior versus fresh outer-terminal inner XQC with depth-wise interleaving of collection and updates.

prior.description: Execute the persistent actor tanh mean with no imagined work; reuse matching prior bundles from the MPPI comparison.

xqc.description: Outer-terminal XQC with step updates: collect one imagined depth, append its transitions, then run one critic, actor and temperature update before the next depth. Preserve J6/N512/H3/G3/batch512 and 9,216 model transitions. Inner-only policy delay one gives C18/A18/T18; retain outer learner delay three. Only final-horizon bootstrap uses the frozen outer actor and online outer critic, retaining current inner alpha; earlier bootstrap and frozen real reward scaling are unchanged.
